local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local VirtualInputManager = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

print("✅ АВТОМАТ ЗАПУЩЕН!")

-- ========== НАСТРОЙКИ ==========
local attackDelay = 1950 -- ЗАДЕРЖКА УДАРА (мс)
local teleportDelay = 700 -- ЗАДЕРЖКА ТЕЛЕПОРТА (мс)

-- ========== КООРДИНАТЫ ==========
local POINT_1 = Vector3.new(66, 441, -110)
local POINT_2 = Vector3.new(243.81, 440.89, -323.50)
local ANGLE_2 = 25

-- ========== ПЕРЕМЕННЫЕ ==========
local isRunning = false
local cycleThread = nil

-- ========== ФУНКЦИИ ==========
local function Jump()
    local character = player.Character
    if character then
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end
end

local function Attack()
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
    end)
    task.wait(0.1)
    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
        task.wait(0.05)
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.Escape, false, game)
    end)
end

local function Teleport1()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(66, 441, -110)
end

local function Teleport2()
    local character = player.Character
    if not character then return end
    local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local angleRad = math.rad(ANGLE_2)
    root.CFrame = CFrame.new(POINT_2) * CFrame.Angles(0, angleRad, 0)
end

local function StartCycle()
    if isRunning then return end
    isRunning = true
    cycleThread = task.spawn(function()
        while isRunning do
            Jump()
            task.wait(0.001)
            if not isRunning then break end
            Teleport1()
            task.wait(teleportDelay / 1000)
            if not isRunning then break end
            Attack()
            task.wait(attackDelay / 1000)
            if not isRunning then break end
            Teleport2()
            task.wait(teleportDelay / 1000)
            if not isRunning then break end
            Attack()
            task.wait(attackDelay / 1000)
            if not isRunning then break end
        end
        isRunning = false
    end)
end

local function StopCycle()
    if not isRunning then return end
    isRunning = false
    if cycleThread then
        task.cancel(cycleThread)
        cycleThread = nil
    end
end

-- ========== СОЗДАЁМ КНОПКИ ==========
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
screenGui.Name = "AutoCycleGUI"

local startBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
startBtn.Parent = screenGui

startBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -25)

startBtn.TextSize = 18
startBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local stopBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
stopBtn.Parent = screenGui
stopBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 50)
stopBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 10, 0.5, -25)
stopBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
stopBtn.Text = "⏹ СТОП"
stopBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
stopBtn.TextSize = 18
stopBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Parent = screenGui
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 0)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 0, 0)
closeBtn.Text = "✕"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isRunning = false
    if cycleThread then
        task.cancel(cycleThread)
        cycleThread = nil
    end
    screenGui:Destroy()
end)

startBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(StartCycle)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(StopCycle)

local function MakeDraggable(topbarobject, object)
	local Dragging = nil
	local DragInput = nil
	local DragStart = nil
	local StartPosition = nil

	local function Update(input)
		local Delta = input.Position - DragStart
		local pos =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
		object.Position = pos
	end

	topbarobject.InputBegan:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				Dragging = true
				DragStart = input.Position
				StartPosition = object.Position

				input.Changed:Connect(
					function()
						if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
							Dragging = false
						end
					end
				)
			end
		end
	)

	topbarobject.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				DragInput = input
			end
		end
	)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input == DragInput and Dragging then
				Update(input)
			end
		end
	)
end

	if not part:IsA("BasePart") or not floorY then
		return
	end
	local cf, size = part.CFrame, part.Size
	local halfHeight = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * size.X / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y) * size.Y / 2
		+ math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y) * size.Z / 2
	if cf.Position.Y + halfHeight > floorY + 1.5 then
		if part.CanCollide then
			disabled[part] = true
			part.CanCollide = false
		end
	elseif disabled[part] then
		disabled[part] = nil
		part.CanCollide = true
	end
end

local function scan()
	for _, name in ipairs({ "ActiveMaps", "Lobby" }) do
		local root = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		if root then
			for _, part in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
				check(part)
			end
		end
	end
end

	floor.CFrame = CFrame.new(root.Position.X, floorY - 0.5, root.Position.Z)
	elapsed = elapsed + dt

-------------------------------------------------
-- TRANSLATION FUNCTION
-------------------------------------------------

local function translateText(text, targetLang)

    local url =
        "https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single" ..
        "?client=gtx" ..
        "&sl=en" ..
        "&tl=" .. targetLang ..
        "&dt=t&q=" .. HttpService:UrlEncode(text)

    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(url)
    end)

    if not success then
        return "HTTP Failed"
    end

    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
    end)

    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Decode Failed"
    end

    if data and data[1] and data[1][1] and data[1][1][1] then
        return data[1][1][1]
    end

    return "Translation Error"
end

-------------------------------------------------

local function doTranslate()

    local text = inputBox.Text

    if text == "" then
        return
    end

    outputLabel.Text = "Translating..."

    local translated = translateText(text, selectedLanguage)

    outputLabel.Text = translated

    pcall(function()

        if setclipboard then
            setclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"

        elseif toclipboard then
            toclipboard(translated)
            outputLabel.Text = translated .. " (Copied)"
        end
    end)
end

translateButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doTranslate)

-------------------------------------------------
-- ENTER KEY SUPPORT
-------------------------------------------------

inputBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)

    if enterPressed then
        doTranslate()
    end
end)
